Phone-satellite for technical experiment purposes. It is planned to be 98x98x7mm dimension.
Description

CAMSAT assists National University of Defense Technology of China to build a Phone-satellite for technical experiment purposes. It is planned to be 98x98x7mm dimension regular square shape and approx. 100g mass. 
Notes

Unclear whether it is a picosatellite or attached to a 1U CubeSat as on the picture. May be some mix-up between object names and NORAD IDs with 40900.
